en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large group of people gathered outdoors on a hillside. In the foreground sit many Indigenous women in traditional dress and bowler hats, with baskets and bottles on the ground, and a few men in suits among them. Behind them stands another group of men, some with musical instruments like drums. Along the right border, printed vertically, is a caption indicating the scene and its location.
